episodes.title: When The Cult In The Horror Movie Is Real
episodes.description:
When The Cult In The Horror Movie Is Real

The Sacrament looks like a found footage movie about a VICE crew visiting a commune in the jungle. It's really a near beat-for-beat reconstruction of the Jonestown massacre, and the movie never once tells you that on screen.

I go through the whole film and line it up with what actually happened in Guyana in November 1978. That means Congressman Leo Ryan flying in with an NBC news crew and worried families, the note a member slipped to a reporter during the welcome party, the ambush on the Port Kaituma airstrip, and Jim Jones's last night with the Peoples Temple. Almost every major scene in Ti West's movie has a real event behind it, and once you know that, it gets a lot harder to watch.
